section_summary: This section records U.S. handling of visits by Japanese transports and training vessels to California and Hawaiian ports in 1938–1939. It includes customs correspondence about cargo loaded by Shintoku Maru at Hilo, Japanese requests for port visits, State Department referrals, and replies about courtesies and crew landing. The final pages begin arrangements for Shintoku Maru’s 1939 training cruise.

subfiles.title: Treasury transmittal concerning Shintoku Maru cargo
subfiles.about: Forwards customs correspondence about merchandise loaded by Shintoku Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Honolulu collector’s report and Treasury’s reply.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply to Honolulu collector
subfiles.about: Addresses the cargo loaded by Shintoku Maru at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Treasury finds no customs violation and refers the matter to Commerce.

subfiles.title: Report on cargo loaded by Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Reports donated scrap and merchandise loaded at Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Hiberly requested export papers and suspected the reported 40,000-pound quantity was understated.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on Shiriya
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Shiriya’s altered Honolulu stay for repairs.
subfiles.summary: The Hawaiian Department was informed.

subfiles.title: Duty-free admission of Shiriya repair parts
subfiles.about: Authorizes duty-free entry of boiler tubes and accessories for Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: The parts were due aboard Chichibu Maru.

subfiles.title: Notice to Japanese Ambassador on Shiriya parts
subfiles.about: Confirms duty-free admission of Shiriya repair materials.
subfiles.summary: Treasury authorized the Honolulu collector to admit 400 boiler tubes and accessories.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on altered Shiriya dates
subfiles.about: Approves changed dates for Shiriya’s Honolulu visit.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities were told to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: Internal memorandum on training-ship cargo
subfiles.about: Analyzes Shintoku Maru’s cargo against training practices and U.S. navigation law.
subfiles.summary: Japanese training vessels could carry cargo for instruction, but U.S. law required a manifest before clearance. Commerce sought a report from Honolulu; the Maritime Commission was preparing a report on merchant-seamen training.

subfiles.title: Commerce transmittal on Shintoku Maru
subfiles.about: Forwards a customs letter concerning Shintoku Maru’s departure from Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the collector’s report.

subfiles.title: Customs report on Shintoku Maru export papers
subfiles.to: Bureau of Marine Inspection and Navigation
subfiles.about: Lists cargo shipped from Hilo to Kobe and confirms filing of export papers.
subfiles.summary: Captain Ito filed a manifest; Kawasaki filed declarations for tires, scrap metals, and merchandise. The printed 1938 date conflicts with the referenced December 1938 request.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Iroo and Shiriya visits
subfiles.about: Requests approval, courtesies, and crew landing for two transports.
subfiles.summary: Iroo and Shiriya would take on petroleum at Los Angeles and provisions in Hawaii.

subfiles.title: State referral to Navy on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests Navy’s view and courtesies for Iroo and Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: Includes schedules and asks about crew landing.

subfiles.title: State referral to Agriculture on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Iroo and Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: Relays the planned California and Hawaii visits.

subfiles.title: State referral to Treasury on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Iroo and Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: Relays the planned California and Hawaii visits.

subfiles.title: State referral to Labor on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies and raises crew landing for two transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays Iroo’s and Shiriya’s proposed visits.

subfiles.title: State referral to War on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies and advice on crew landing.
subfiles.summary: Relays Iroo’s and Shiriya’s proposed visits.

subfiles.title: State referral to Interior on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for two Japanese transports.
subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed California and Hawaii schedule.

subfiles.title: State referral to California Governor on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Seeks California’s response to the proposed transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Requests usual courtesies during the Los Angeles calls.

subfiles.title: Interim reply to Japanese Ambassador on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the proposed visits pending agency replies.
subfiles.summary: State will report whether the visits are approved after consulting federal departments and California.

subfiles.title: Final reply to Japanese Ambassador on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Approves the two transports’ visits and normal shore leave.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: Labor reply on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the proposed visits of Iroo and Shiriya.
subfiles.summary: Immigration field officers were informed.

subfiles.title: War reply on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Approves courtesies and unarmed crew landing.
subfiles.summary: Army commands in California and Hawaii received instructions.

subfiles.title: Interior reply on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Reports the Hawaiian Governor’s approval of the visits.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies, including crew landing, will be extended.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies at Los Angeles, Honolulu, and Hilo.
subfiles.summary: Local collectors were instructed.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on Iroo and Shiriya
subfiles.about: Approves the visits and normal shore leave.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: California inquiry about transport courtesies
subfiles.about: Accepts the visits but asks what California officials should provide.
subfiles.summary: The Governor seeks guidance on expected entertainment.

subfiles.title: Reply to California on transport courtesies
subfiles.about: Clarifies California’s role during Iroo’s and Shiriya’s calls.
subfiles.summary: State officials need not entertain officers; the local naval officer handles customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for Erimo visit

subfiles.title: State referral to Interior on Erimo

subfiles.title: State referral to Labor on Erimo

subfiles.summary: Relays the transport’s April–May calls.

subfiles.title: State referral to Navy on Erimo

subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed Los Angeles and Honolulu visits.

subfiles.title: State referral to War on Erimo
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies and advice on Erimo’s crew landing.
subfiles.summary: Relays the proposed port calls.

subfiles.title: State referral to Treasury on Erimo
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The surviving copy omits most visit details.

subfiles.title: State referral to California Governor on Erimo
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Erimo’s Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Relays the transport’s California and Hawaii schedule.

subfiles.title: Interim reply to Japanese Ambassador on Erimo
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Erimo’s proposed visits pending consultations.
subfiles.summary: State will advise whether approval is granted.

subfiles.title: Final reply to Japanese Ambassador on Erimo
subfiles.about: Approves Erimo’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Usual courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: Labor reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Acknowledges Erimo’s proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: Immigration field officers were informed.

subfiles.title: Duplicate Labor reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Duplicates notice to immigration field officers about Erimo.
subfiles.summary: Copy of the preceding reply.

subfiles.title: Labor reply with field-copy notation
subfiles.about: Records circulation of Erimo visit information.
subfiles.summary: Copies were supplied to district directors in Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: Additional Labor copy on Erimo
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Erimo field notification.
subfiles.summary: Notes copies for Los Angeles and Honolulu officers.

subfiles.title: Faint Labor copy on Erimo
subfiles.about: Another degraded copy of the Erimo notification.
subfiles.summary: Field officers are advised of the transport’s visit.

subfiles.title: State’s Labor referral copy on Erimo
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: A clearer copy of the referral on page 194.

subfiles.title: War reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Approves courtesies and crew landing without arms.
subfiles.summary: Army commanders in California and Hawaii were instructed.

subfiles.title: Navy reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Approves Erimo’s port visits.
subfiles.summary: Local naval authorities will provide usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: California reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Confirms California will extend customary courtesies to Erimo.
subfiles.summary: The Governor’s office acknowledges the planned visit.

subfiles.title: Treasury reply on Erimo
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs courtesies for Erimo.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Los Angeles and Honolulu were instructed.

subfiles.title: Hawaii reply on Erimo
subfiles.from: Territory of Hawaii; forwarded by Ruth Hampton
subfiles.about: Confirms Honolulu will extend port courtesies to Erimo.
subfiles.summary: Interior forwarded the territorial reply to State.

subfiles.title: Japanese request for 1939 Training Squadron visits
subfiles.about: Requests approval for Yakumo and Iwate to visit four U.S. ports.
subfiles.summary: The proposed calls are Honolulu, San Francisco, San Pedro, and Hilo from October through November 1939.

subfiles.summary: Relays the four-port schedule.

subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Yakumo and Iwate.
subfiles.summary: Relays the four-port schedule.

subfiles.about: Acknowledges the squadron request pending U.S. replies.

subfiles.title: War reply on Training Squadron

subfiles.title: Labor reply on Training Squadron

subfiles.summary: Personnel should receive every courtesy consistent with immigration rules.
